info.bio:
Squirrel Bait was a mid 1980's punk band from Louisville, Kentucky. The primary lineup included Peter Searcy (vocals), David Grubbs (guitar), Brian McMahan (guitar), Clark Johnson (bass), and Ben Daughtrey (drums). 

Guitarist David Grubbs was subsequently a member of Bitch Magnet, Bastro and Gastr del Sol and has released a number of solo projects. Drummer Ben Daughtrey played with the Lemonheads and then with Love Jones. McMahan, Buckler, and Walford later formed the highly influential Slint

scenes.name: Noise-rock y noise-pop
scenes.author: Piero Scaruffi
scenes.desc: Sonic Youth acuñan el «noise-rock»: aún obedece las reglas del rock'n'roll, pero secuestrado por sonidos disonantes. En Nueva York, Rat At Rat R, Agitpop, Ritual Tension, Gut Bank, la triple guitarra de Band Of Susans, Of Cabbages And Kings, Spongehead, Alice Donut. Boston da los grupos más influyentes de la década siguiente: Dinosaur Jr (el estándar «noise-pop», fusión de distorsión y melodía, eslabón entre Sonic Youth y el grunge) y los Pixies (Surfer Rosa, Doolittle). El art-punk del Sur (Antietam, Squirrel Bait, Blind Idiot God, Alter Natives) y los excéntricos de San Francisco (Tragic Mulatto, Slovenly).

podcast.title: Seminal Hardcore Act
podcast.body: Brian McMahan and Britt Walford were part of Squirrel Bait when they were 14 years old. The band is described as a seminal hardcore act and a precursor to the "mocor" (grunge) sound, with its members growing up in proximity to and interacting with other significant bands of the era. "Con 14 formaron parte de Squire-El-Bate, la seminal de hardcore y el sonido de mocor. Estos niñas programistas, con pintas de net, literalmente crecieron y secodeado en con Gisquier-Dew, Black Flug o Big Black."
